column1: # Retrieval eval set for ast-bro itself, so the harness runs against a checkout
# that is always present. Smaller and Rust-only, so treat it as a smoke test
# rather than as evidence — pgjdbc.tsv is the set to judge a change on.
# No pinned revision: this set runs against the working tree on purpose, since
# the corpus is the code you are changing. That also means its scores are not
# comparable across commits — use pgjdbc.tsv for that.
# One query per line: <natural-language query> TAB <file> TAB <symbol>.
widen a buffer of half precision values into single precision
turn a string into a normalized embedding vector
find the nearest embedding rows by cosine similarity
decide where to cut a source file into indexable pieces
build the signature-only documents for a file
group split regions into chunks under the size target
label a chunk with the declaration that encloses it
rank files by how well their outline matches the query
promote chunks whose file scored well earlier
which text is handed to the embedding model
add the file name and breadcrumb to the lexical document
apply path penalties and pick the final results
lift a file whose chunks all score well
penalise test files and generated code by path
blend two ranked lists using reciprocal rank fusion
choose how much weight the dense retriever gets
break a camelCase identifier into separate words
peel language and path filters out of a raw query
detect which files changed since the index was built
score documents with the BM25 ranking formula
